assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pre-rendered sprite atlas for a realistic isometric cyberpunk tactics game. EXACTLY THREE columns in ONE row, equal square cells, landscape 1536x512. One object per cell. Three damage states of EXACT SAME object at EXACT SAME scale, ground position and camera. Orthographic 30 degree elevated view, symmetrical isometric axes, nearest ground corner points straight down. Each square object occupies a 2 metre by 2 metre diamond footprint. Ground footprint left/right/front corners MUST stay identical in all three cells, including wreckage. Each cell object fits with 10 percent margin, no overlap between cells. Column 1 intact with weathered surfaces. Column 2 visibly battle-damaged, holes, dents, broken panels, but still standing and blocking a shot. Column 3 completely destroyed: low collapsed recognizable wreckage below ankle height, passable scattered remains contained WITHIN original footprint; no upright blocking walls. No explosion, no fire, no smoke, no ground, no cast shadow, no people, no UI, no text or grid. Transparent alpha background, if unavailable uniform pure white. Detailed worn materials, cool blue ambient light, restrained cyan rim left and crimson rim right. Match the supplied reference object's rendering style; reference is STYLE ONLY, do not duplicate its subject. Subject: a sealed industrial steel cargo crate with dark navy framing, olive panels and amber latches. Intact waist-high cubic silhouette. Damaged has torn panel and bullet holes. Wreckage has flattened recognizable navy frame, separated olive plates and latches.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production modular game sprite atlas for a realistic isometric cyberpunk tactical battlefield, navy and olive utility delivery truck with subtle cyan and red rim lighting, worn industrial materials. EXACTLY TWO columns and THREE rows of equal square cells, portrait 1024x1536, six separate sprites. Left column is ONLY rear cargo-box half with rear wheels. Right column is ONLY cab and engine half with front wheels, windshield, hood and bumper, NO cargo box. These two modules join end to end to make ONE coherent small delivery truck: cargo at upper left of assembled truck, nose points lower right; 30 degree elevated orthographic camera. Each module ground footprint is a 2m by 2m square, projected as a symmetric diamond with nearest corner straight down. Same camera, scale and registration in all cells; generous white space. Row1 both modules intact. Row2 same modules shot up, punched panels and cracked glass, still full-height. Row3 BOTH modules completely collapsed into LOW WALKABLE wreckage below ankle height: cargo flattened box plates and rear axle; cab flattened crushed hood, wheels, windshield fragments and engine debris. No upright cab or box in row3. The two modules must visually match, no gaps in their assembled ground footprint. Each module isolated in its own cell, no neighboring module, no ground or shadow, no smoke or flames, no people or text or gridlines, transparent alpha background or pure white if unavailable. High-detail pre-rendered 3D game art. Reference image is material/rendering style only.
